name: FormKeep Free
free_limit: Free hosted form backend with unlimited forms, 50 submissions per month, spam protection, a form designer, branded thank-you page, daily email notifications and one-month submission retention.
watch_out: Submissions beyond the monthly free limit are ignored; real-time notifications, custom redirects, webhooks, attachments and longer retention require paid plans. Free tier displays FormKeep branding. Confirm commercial-use terms before business-critical deployment.
